items.title: Smelloff ODORSTRIKE Fabric Odor Eliminator Spray (50ml)
items.description: A pocket-sized fabric odor remover spray for clothes. 50ml mist that targets trapped sweat odor, gym smell, and shirt odor in fabric — HPβCD (cyclodextrin) traps odor molecules, Zinc PCA helps neutralize them, Triethyl Citrate helps prevent odor formation, and Zinc Gluconate supports long-lasting fabric freshness. Up to 8 hours odor protection on fabric under normal office/commute conditions. Glycerine-free and fast-drying; dries clear with no stiff residue when sprayed from 15–20 cm. Not a perfume. Not a deodorant. Fabric-only. Works on cotton, polyester, denim, and wool.
